doc.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025

title: His son and Colgate Boys State memories
summary: A tangent about his son's teaching and his own visit to Colgate for American Legion Boys State in high school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Syracuse I think he was at.

He was at Syracuse but he played in an orchestra that was either in Hamilton or Colgate, I can’t remember. Because I went there but I wasn’t there in the day I was there at night just to hear his rehearsal.
I did go to Colgate when I was in high school though. I went to American Legion Boys State.
And I played a solo with the band at the All-State. You know you got appointed by your local county. I don’t even remember. But I loved it up there. All I remember was you had to walk up this hill.
Yes, lots of hills at Colgate.

And it was hot. And I was trying to figure out how I could only walk up the hill once, you know, because it was so hot there. You know and I’m from New York, from Long Island you know so we knew what the summers were like but not like that when you were walking up that hill. We didn’t have those hills on Long Island.
